I replied to Ilse in a thread on her message in #north-random. I said I've noted that the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is 100 seats, and that I haven't changed anything, as she asked.

I also told her that her #north-team post still shows the old number and she may want to fix it there. I didn't open #north-team to check; I went by her own message, which says that post has the wrong figure.
